channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Medics in Iran arrested for treating wounded protesters
item.description: Amid the escalating rhetoric, we have been speaking to a doctor inside Iran who reveals that injured demonstrators were being executed in their hospital beds while seeking treatment.

item.title: ‘Iranian regime increasingly has nothing to lose’ – director of international crisis group
item.description: We spoke to Ali Vaez, director of the Iran project at the international crisis group and a mediator in the 2015 Iran nuclear deal

item.title: Starmer visits Xi: First UK PM to make trip to China in eight years
item.description: Sir Keir Starmer has arrived in Beijing for a three day visit to China - the first trip by a British prime minister for eight years.

item.title: No longer a ‘clear line between democracy and dictatorship’ – Ai Weiwei
item.description: We speak to the Chinese artist and activist Ai Weiwei.

item.title: ICE agents involved in Alex Pretti shooting placed on leave
item.description: The federal agents involved in shooting dead the nurse Alex Pretti in Minnesota during an anti-ICE protest at the weekend have been placed on administrative leave, according to officials - who claimed it was "standard procedure".

item.title: Welsh council to demolish homes that cannot be saved from floods
item.description: After another day of severe weather warnings around the country, residents of one south Wales street live in constant fear at the thought of more flooding.

item.title: Russian attack on Ukrainian passenger train kills five people
item.description: Russia and Ukraine have lost a total of almost two million military personnel in the four years since Russia's full scale invasion, according to a new study.

item.title: Dame Sarah Mullally becomes first female Archbishop of Canterbury
item.description: Dame Sarah Mullally has been confirmed as the 106th Archbishop of Canterbury with a pledge to tackle misogyny and bring peace to a "fractured world".

item.title: Will Anglican communion be split over female Archbishop?
item.description: We were joined by the Reverend Dr Ian Paul who's a member of the General Synod.

item.title: On the frontline with Somalis standing up to ICE in Minnesota
item.description: Minnesota has the largest Somali population of anywhere in the United States and they've become the target of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown.
